changelog: **Stage automation engine (#1703):** new `AutomationRule` / `AutomationRun` models (both in `TENANT_MODELS`) and the `automation` domain-event subscriber on `pipeline.stage_change`. A rule (entry/exit of one stage, AND-ed allowlisted conditions, an ordered list of allowlisted actions, optional delay) is validated at write time by `parseRuleInput()` (`src/lib/automation/rule.ts`): actions are `notifyRole`, `sendTemplateEmail` (catalogued EN/TR/DE templates through `sendEmail()`), `setStageDeadline`, `assignGoalFromTemplate`, `requireDocument`, `addTag` — none takes a URL, an address or free text, none moves a stage. Evaluation runs on the queue (a bulk advance never waits on it), records exactly one run per (rule, event), delays go through the new `automation.run` job, a failing action leaves a PARTIAL/FAILED run and never touches the stage move. Rules default to disabled; the admin builder is #1704. `docs/automation-rules.md`.
